answer: Use a burst-arrival quarantine queue: flag any gale of first requests from many identities within one short window. The rule holds them until spaced traffic appears across three time bins, with a prism separating synchronized bursts from steady streams, before normal limits apply. Each identity pays a unique egress path and clock held idle ten minutes plus scheduled probes; willow-like sparse arrivals clear cheaply, but mass sybils must buy staggered timing and patience per identity.
